description: Fires when the opponent has a vertical stack of their stones on top of the centre column (col 3): strongest (top activations) when three opponent stones are stacked there, raised off the bottom row (rows 1-3 or 2-4), with the cell above empty so I must block. Two stacked at rows 2-3 fires weakly; the same stacks in other columns, my own stacks, or a full/capped column 3 mostly do not.
effect: Pushes the move toward column 3 (the block): forcing it high on weaker positions raises column 3 by about 16-20 points, mostly taken from column 4; zeroing it changes nothing measurable; in real must-block positions column 3 is already ~100%.
notes: Top bands are clean: opponent vertical three in col 3 (elevated) with must-block. Minimal pairs: same stack in col 2 ~0.5, cols 1/4/5 ~0; at rows 0-2 only ~0.1; flips off when the stack is mine; full column kills it. Near-threshold firing is diffuse (single/two O stones atop col 3, context-dependent), limiting F1. Best dev F1 0.462 (P 0.40, R 0.55, AUROC 0.76), simulation share 0.92. Capping when I have my own win hurt simulation. Synthesis up to 15.57 > dev max 14.64.
